description.en: Simple drawings made step by step in black pen on paper, with a single red accent.
description.tr: Kağıt üzerinde siyah kalemle adım adım çizilen sade çizimler, tek kırmızı vurgu.

colorRules.accent: circles, underlines, arrows and the one highlighted object; never for whole drawings

hand.use: all on-screen writing: numbers, labels, short notes, headlines

stroke.overshoot: line ends may overshoot corners by a few px, like a quick marker

draw.type: every stroke draws on along its path (stroke-dashoffset)

hatch.type: hatching is a quick scribble, drawn much faster than outlines

motion.order: outline first, then details, then hatching, then the red accent

write.type: handwritten text reveals letter by letter with a left to right wipe

erase.type: a quick wipe across the drawing clears it

motion.camera: slow pan or zoom across one big sheet, like following a pen on a whiteboard
motion.noMovementAfterDrawn: drawn lines never move or bounce; only the camera moves
